node.title: Re: Error in IIS server for Perl script
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: It appears you're working from some really, really old code examples: no [doc://warnings], no [doc://strict], cgi-lib, calling functions with &, writing old-style HTML by hand, ... I would strongly recommend using a newer codebase / tutorial! See e.g. [id://1182902].
